articleTitle: Keynotes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Provides an abstract for each of the invited presentations and may include a brief professional biography of each presenter. The complete presentations were not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: Durability Life Prediction Technology of Port Hydraulic Structure Driven by the Fusion of Digital Twins and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Digital twin has the characteristics of high- fidelity behavior simulation, and deep learning has powerful data mining capabilities. Our country's port and hydraulic building facilities are now the world's largest, most of which are concrete structures. However, there will be more freeze-thaw damage to concrete structures, and there is less research on the durability test methods of hydraulic structures, especially the life prediction of hydraulic structures after freeze-thaw damage repairs. Based on this, this article has launched a research on the durability life prediction technology of port hydraulic structures driven by the integration of digital twins and deep learning. Aiming at the difficult problem of predicting and maintaining the status of port hydraulic buildings in a harsh working environment, combined with the high-fidelity behavior simulation characteristics of digital twins and the powerful data mining capabilities of deep learning, this paper mainly studies the mutual driving of digital twins and deep learning. In this paper, multiple digital twins of the shearer are constructed based on multiple physical and spatial parameters. Through multiple visual displays and data analysis in the virtual space, the health status is predicted, and a port based on deep machine learning is established. The residual life prediction model of the key parts of hydraulic structures realizes real-time monitoring on the network; integrates the residual life and residual life value of the building parts driven by data, and integrates the status of the digital twin and the residual life of the parts and the port Durability assessment of hydraulic construction buildings. The research results show that although a little steel slag can significantly improve the heat resistance and compressive strength of concrete, when the content of steel slag exceeds a certain meaning, the heat resistance and compressive strength of concrete will change. When the steel slag content reaches 10%, the effect is best. When the steel slag content reaches 20%, the 28d concrete compressive strength and strength will not have a big impact.

articleTitle: Research on AI-assisted Hybrid Teaching for English Writing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In order to improve the quality of English writing teaching, this paper first describes the research background of the hybrid teaching mode under the background of artificial intelligence, and then discusses the application of the hybrid teaching mode in English writing teaching under the background of artificial intelligence from four aspects of pre-class, in-class, after-class and diversified teaching evaluation, exploring the auxiliary effects of artificial intelligence on English writing teaching and students' autonomous learning. It is proposed that the application of artificial intelligence technology can effectively assist teachers to complete composition correction and data analysis more efficiently, help solve the problem of students' low self-efficacy in writing learning, and is expected to cultivate students' self-awareness of English writing and lifelong learning.

articleTitle: Practical Teaching of Management Accounting Course under the Background of Artificial Intelligence and Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology and artificial intelligence, the accounting profession is undergoing earth-shaking changes, and its service model has changed from data processing after the event to planning in advance and participating in management decisions. These are the characteristics of management accounting. If accountants are simply proficient in finance, they lack the connection with business, do not understand business, and cannot extract valuable information from financial big data to provide solutions or suggestions for business development, which is a waste of data resources and even misleading decision-making. Today's finance should not only integrate into business, but also deal with data, so as to give full play to the functions of supervision and management decision-making, help improve business quality, and at the same time, make value creation develop to a higher end. The important task of higher education is to train high-quality professionals and cultivate a group of top-notch talents in this major. The same is true of management accounting [1]. At present, there is a shortage of market management accounting talents. How to cultivate high-quality management accounting talents, improve the practical ability of management accounting students, and quickly integrate into society to be a qualified management accounting, the key to professional teaching is to make students familiar with business and understand business processes, and to have management practice courses with quality and quantity.

articleTitle: The Application of Artificial Intelligence to Security Management at the Context of Higher Education in China
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the development process of security information construction in Colleges and universities, with the popularization of modern Internet, virtualization, intelligence and other information technology, as well as the maturing of digital campus and smart campus planning in the next few years, it will provide the best information technology selection and favorable infrastructure guarantee for the implementation of security monitoring management system in colleges and universities in the new era. The purpose of this paper is to design an intelligent management system for university security through in-depth study of the role of artificial intelligence in university security management so as to improve the ability of university security. This paper mainly applies SOA and J2EE technology, based on SOA and J2EE server and mobile client, aiming at the main hidden dangers of the current campus security, designs and implements a campus security intelligent management system, which includes four functions: daily office, hidden danger management, evaluation management and security information management. Among them, daily office design includes resource sharing, notice and announcement. Hidden danger management design includes hidden danger supervision, hidden danger statistics and uncorrected hidden danger inquiry. Evaluation management includes evaluation score entry, subordinate unit evaluation and annual ranking management. Safety information management includes safety information browsing, safety information query and safety information statistics. Finally, after the system debugging, the error of each module test is 0, the system can achieve the required functions and effectively improve the campus security management.

articleTitle: Training Mode of Information Management and Information System Professionals in Colleges and Universities Based on the Development Direction of Computer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the development of new technology revolution and the continuous change of economic structure, the number of information management and information system professionals in Colleges and universities is increasing based on the direction of computer development. The Ministry of education and universities take many measures to promote the reform and development of talent training mode. Based on this, the paper adopts the method of questionnaire survey and improvement of research mode. This paper first collects relevant data, lays a theoretical foundation for this research, and compares and analyzes the current computer development direction of information management and information system professional talent training mode and traditional training mode, and establishes a training mechanism group to explore the training mechanism of management accounting talents in the direction of integration of business and finance driven by big data, and introduces the mechanism of training accounting talents Details and evaluation indicators of. From the perspective of computer development direction, according to the test theory method and technology, the function and performance of the training mechanism are verified completely, and the comparison and analysis are made with the traditional talent training mechanism. Among them, the evaluation indexes mainly include satisfaction with the cultivation of professional talents and the competency required by the information management and information system professionals in Colleges and universities. The results show that the proportion of competency needed by the professionals of information management and information system is 44.4%. This shows that through the innovation of the training mechanism of management accounting personnel and the improvement of the training mode through the analysis results, the talents of information management and information system in Colleges and universities can be trained with both theory and practice and meet the actual needs.

articleTitle: On the Innovation of Blended Teaching Mode of New Engineering Based on “Artificial Intelligence +”
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The rapid rise and wide application of emerging information technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), big data, cloud computing and Internet of things in the field of education technology, to a large extent, have changed the teaching mode of new engineering courses and rapidly promoted the reform of higher education. In this paper, the case method and logical empirical evaluation method are used to explore the full and flexible application of artificial intelligence technology means combined with new engineering courses, to create a new engineering intelligent class, and to carry out AI transformation, so as to make education and teaching deeply integrated with AI and develop towards intelligent and efficient development, promote blended teaching and build a deep integrated ecological chain, and form an interactive development mode of sustainable innovation and double helix evolution.

articleTitle: Research on Interaction Design Thinking Innovation in Mobile Application Software Operation Interface
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Take the behavior process as the design object, adhere to the “user centered” design principle, refine the level of user needs, establish the user psychological model and interactive behavior model from the perspective of psychological perception level and operational behavior level, combine the aesthetic theory and methodology of art design, reasonably arrange and deal with the visual elements and interface layout. So as to improve the usability of smart phone app.

articleTitle: Image Super-resolution Reconstruction Based on Multi-layer Parallel Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The existing methods can improve the overall visual effect of the image, but the reconstructed image is still lack of high-frequency information, leading to texture blur. To solve these problems, this paper proposes an image super-resolution reconstruction algorithm based on multi-layer parallel convolution and residual network. Taking the multilayer parallel structure as the whole framework, firstly, different convolution combinations are used to enrich the feature information of the parallel structure, and the jump connection is added to further enrich the feature and fuse the output to extract more high-frequency information. Secondly, an adaptive residual network is introduced to supplement information and optimize network performance. Finally, perceptual loss is used to improve the overall quality of the restored image. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm performs well for the reconstructed image, and the PSNR and structural similarity are significantly improved in the objective evaluation.

articleTitle: A Research on Using Artificial Intelligence Information Technology to Enhance the Effectiveness of English Language Learning ---- An example of learning college English
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Recently, in the process of rapid socio-economic development, artificial intelligence information technology has begun to be applied in various fields and has made good progress, especially in the field of education, where the use of artificial intelligence information technology enables students to interact and communicate with the system during learning, participate in learning activities according to their own learning level, and make self-correction and practice with the deficiencies and problems fed back by system. The system allows students to practice and improve their learning effectiveness. Therefore, in order to improve students' learning effectiveness, the use of AI information technology should be actively utilized in college English teaching, guiding students to use AI information technology for independent learning and interactive communication, combining their basic English learning ability and learning objectives to participate deeply in interactive learning activities, mobilizing students' interest while improving their learning effectiveness and laying a solid foundation for the subsequent development.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Foreign Language Teaching Mode in the Era of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Since the advent of computer and artificial intelligence technology, the whole world has set off an information technology revolution, especially now the information technology is more and more developed and mature, which also indicates that the era of BDT has come. Under the influence of big data, great changes have taken place in the working methods and modes of all walks of life. In the new era of education industry, the traditional teaching concept can not adapt to the development of the times, especially the comprehensive foreign language education vigorously promoted by the Ministry of Education. Now, due to the emergence of BDT (big data technology), many educators try to apply BDT to the comprehensive foreign language teaching mode. This paper selects two foreign language universities as experimental objects to explore the effects and repercussions of the combination of BDT and comprehensive foreign language teaching mode. BDT is used in the comprehensive foreign language teaching mode of University A, while the traditional teaching method is still used in University B. The results show that the teachers and students of University A have a high evaluation of the new teaching mode, and the teachers' score is basically above 85, even the highest score is 93. The percentage of students who are satisfied with the new teaching mode is 75%, which is far more than half the total number of people surveyed.

articleTitle: The Principle, Method and Effect of Imagery Practice in Swimming Teaching in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The difficulties of swimming teaching in Colleges and universities are unfamiliar water environment and unaccustomed horizontal posture, and the formation of skills depends on the body's proprioception. Appearance can get rid of the direct stimulation of things, reproduce the image of things, reduce the constraints of time and space, so as to reduce the difficulty of teaching. The method is to establish visual imagery, practice the combination of visual imagery and kinesthetic imagery, and form swimming skills mainly relying on kinesthetic imagery. Imagery practice improves the quality of teaching in terms of time and skills. Based on the practice of good results, some suggestions are put forward.

articleTitle: Practical Teaching Reform of ARM Embedded Technology Based on OBE Concept for Applied Undergraduates
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: ARM embedded technology is a core course for electronic information majors. This course mainly trains electronic, computer and embedded development talents. This course requires extremely high hands-on ability and requires students to be able to engage in software and hardware development and design work in electronics and other industries after completing the course. Especially for application-oriented undergraduate electronics majors, the training of practical skills is more demanding, so this article has developed a practical teaching method based on the OBE concept in response to the current problems of the course. Through practice, this method is of great significance for cultivating applied electronic embedded design talents.

articleTitle: The Influence and Reconstruction of International MOOCS on Chinese College English Curriculum
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper firstly introduces MOOCS (Massive Open Online Courses) and its main characteristics, then it analyzes the challenges of MOOCS to college English Curriculum in China. This paper discusses the reconstruction of College English Curriculum in China: open classroom, elective College English curriculum; flipped classroom, new-style college English teaching method; renewing concept, professionalization of College English teachers.

articleTitle: The Application of Computer 3D Technology in the Protection of Traditional Village Space Form
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper takes computer technology as the main technology, takes the spatial syntax theory as the main theory, and uses the quantitative analysis method of spatial syntax to analyze the spatial form of traditional villages in Nanxi River Basin, which shows the multi-faceted grammatical characteristics contained in the spatial form of traditional villages, According to the comparative study of grammar, the paper summarizes the extensive characteristics of traditional village spatial form and applies it to the maintenance and development trend of traditional village spatial form. The paper introduces the traditional villages in Nanxi River section in detail, and discusses the difficulties encountered in its maintenance and development trend. Three research examples of villages are defined. The three-dimensional simulation space of many traditional villages in Nanxi River reach is established and analyzed by using software syntax analysis mobile phone software depth map and basic theory of spatial grammar. The spatial forms of many traditional villages are qualitatively analyzed. The results of analysis should be illustrated by using the electronic computer grammar mobile phone software. According to the horizontal comparison of the spatial forms of many villages, the paper summarizes the extensive characteristics of the traditional village spatial form of Nanxi River. Finally, according to the above research, the basic principles of the maintenance and development trend of the traditional village space form of Nanxijiang are established.

articleTitle: Influence of “People-oriented” on the Construction of Interactive Interface Design Curriculum System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: From 1970s, Xerox, Apple and various computer research institutes began to discuss ways to provide digital products with more humanity. Among them two engineering designers Bill Moggridge and Bill Verplank created the word “interactive design” when designing the first laptop computer. Since then, human-computer interaction has entered the public's vision. With interactive design more and more being at the forefront of the times, related courses have also been set up in universities. How to build a high-quality curriculum system and to cultivate talented person under market demands will be our studying direction. This article is going to precisely analysis foreign and domestic interactive design industry, and to cite it into the course system research.

articleTitle: The Design of Tourism English Teaching Reform Based on ESP Theory in the Network Information Age
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The network information age refers to the computer age or the digital age, and the impact of information on the entire society has been raised to an absolutely important position. The amount of information, the speed of information dissemination, the speed of information processing, and the degree of applied information are all increasing in a geometric progression. The advantage of the network lies in its abundant resources. The collection and query of network resources is more conducive to the development of educational resources. The rich educational resources in the network information age have expanded the effective connection path between tourism English and EGP from the perspective of ESP, and enriched the teaching reform content of tourism English from the perspective of ESP. Teachers can guide students to use the Internet for real English professional communication. In the process of network interactive communication, the ultimate teaching goal of ESP is realized.

articleTitle: Research on the Application Demonstration of Electromagnetic Launch Technology in the Unmanned Tank
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The subject is illustrated with an unmanned combat vehicle as a case, and it is demonstrated from three aspects: The first is to put forward a demonstration and evaluation plan for the development strategy, system structure, and construction plan of electric power generation technology in the field of unmanned combat vehicles. The second is a comprehensive and systematic demonstration of the necessity, feasibility, risk, performance, overall plan, key technology, combat effectiveness, system contribution rate, quality, standardization, and test identification of the development of power generation technology and equipment models. The third is to provide decision support for the serial development and engineering application of power generation technology and equipment. By promoting the development of electric power generation technology and formulating a development plan for the application of electric power generation technology, we can ensure that our country can calmly cope with the various challenges currently facing the future and provide technical advice to the national defense science and industry departments to ensure scientific, feasibility of implementation, effectiveness of implementation.

articleTitle: The Cultivation System of the Thought-assisted Classroom Learning Community Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the context of the new curriculum reform led by big data, education staff are facing more and more challenges. In order to meet new challenges and promote the development of the education industry, the country and the government, as well as schools and teachers themselves, are exploring and practicing effective ways to improve the overall quality of teaching. As a result, an ideological-assisted classroom learning community has emerged. This article first elaborates the related concepts of the thought-assisted classroom learning community in detail, then establishes a big data-based thought-assisted classroom detailed community cultivation system, and finally uses the system to use the actual teaching, through the comparison of student performance analyze with satisfaction degree, and the analysis results show that the thought-assisted classroom learning community can help students improve their performance.

articleTitle: Corpus Construction of English Courses in Xinjiang Colleges and Universities Based on Computer Network
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The goal of English teaching is to foster morality and to achieve the effect of moisturizing things silently. Cultivate students' critical thinking and creative thinking in English teaching. This article builds a computer network-based corpus to train students to become warm people, learn to tell Chinese stories, spread Chinese voices, and convey Chinese wisdom.

articleTitle: On the Application of Computer Digital Teaching Resources in the Design of English Teaching Curriculum
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the development of information technology such as computer technology, network technology and multimedia technology and its application in education, digital teaching resources are increasingly being favored by people. Digital teaching resources are an important foundation for the implementation of education informatization, and the richness and effective application of digital teaching resources have increasingly attracted the attention of educational technology workers. This article aims to study the application of computer digital teaching resources in English curriculum design. Based on the analysis of the advantages and disadvantages of traditional English teaching, the advantages and problems of digital teaching, the existing problems and the improvement strategies of teachers using digital teaching resources, the questionnaire survey method is used. A survey of teachers in a middle school showed that only 17% of the teachers can complete their own courseware. Most teachers rely on the help of others or download their own multimedia courseware through the download of network resources. Among them, because the school does not provide a corresponding resource platform, some (8%) teachers even choose to pay for the relevant platform to download courseware to support their teaching.

articleTitle: Thinking and Practice of Specialty Construction of Computer Science and Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the context of the popularization of higher education and the rapid development of computer technology, the scale and number of computer science and technology majors in colleges and universities have developed rapidly. The development of related characteristics has become the key to enhancing the competitiveness of colleges and universities, and the construction of characteristic majors has become the most significant sign of characteristic strategies. The purpose of this article is to study the thinking and practice of computer science and technology specialty construction. This paper aims at the subject of computer science and technical specialty construction using literature analysis, qualitative analysis, comparative analysis, and case analysis to analyze and summarize it, and combine the relevant theories of computer science and technical specialty construction to provide a better understanding of computer science in colleges and universities. To sort out the content, principles and existing problems of the specialty construction of technical characteristics, and put forward countermeasures and suggestions for the construction and development of specialty of computer science and technology on this basis. The survey results show that 81.26% of business managers and 35.79% of computer science and technicians believe that the professional courses that students learn at school are highly related to their positions, indicating that the current courses offered by this specialty are relatively close to the needs of related positions in the enterprise.

articleTitle: Application of Learning Behavior Analysis Algorithm Based on Data Mining in the Cultivation of International Talents
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In recent years, data mining, as a wide range of applications, has emerged and been widely used in various fields. At present, the role of data mining in the field of learning is on the rise. The main problem of analyzing learning management is that different learners have different styles and behaviors. We need to evaluate the system from all aspects. In the existing teaching methods, more attention is paid to the evaluation of learners. This paper discusses the evaluation of learning management system, and puts forward a new evaluation method of learning management system. The results show that there are 72 active learners and 31 intuitive learners.

articleTitle: Design of Sports Training Correction System Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of serious insufficiency of the exercise correction system in the personal exercise scene, this paper proposes and designs a prototype system of a virtual personal exercise training device (PAT). Unlike exercise videotapes or live TV broadcasts, this system allows users to independently select the type of exercise, and the guided program will create a virtual trainer that meets the user's settings. Based on the virtual reality technology of computer vision, it can recognize and interpret the motion posture in real time, so as to effectively evaluate the user's motion state and give appropriate feedback at the same time. In this system, the central behavior recognition is designed separately from the user incentive and user feedback modules, and the main line of the system is synchronized, which can realize the seamless connection of recognition, interpretation, background music incentives, etc. This system has the advantages of stable operation and small real-time delay in the test, which can basically meet the needs of personal exercise correction.

articleTitle: A Novel Teaching Mode in Foundation of Machine Manufacturing Technology Course
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Foundation of Machine Manufacturing Technology is an application-oriented course of mechanical specialty. In this course, equal attention to theory and practice should be paid. In order to further improve the teaching effect of the course, a novel teaching mode is proposed in this paper. In this teaching mode, flipped classroom which emphasis on students' autonomous learning ability is introduced. Based on the scientific teaching content and teaching mode design, humanized and fair learning is conducted for students. Furthermore, the problems in this new teaching mode is analyzed. Students' in adaptability, increase of teacher's workload and how to conduct the cooperation of teaching team are the potential problems in this teaching mode. After analyzing the advantages and problems of flipped classroom in the teaching of the Foundation of Machine Manufacturing Technology, methods to improve the quality of teaching are developed.

articleTitle: Teaching Innovation of Practical Courses of Tourism English Major in Higher Vocational Education under the Background of Internet +
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the “Internet +” era, higher vocational education is also the main force to promote my country's modern development. With the rapid development of my country's tourism industry, the society urgently needs relevant talents who are proficient in English and tourism professional knowledge. In order to meet the needs of social development, higher vocational colleges have taken up this important task and opened a major course in tourism English. English courses are particularly important in the study of tourism majors. Higher vocational colleges should seize this opportunity to strengthen the innovation of tourism professional English courses, and strive to train the society to have certain theories and techniques of tourism majors and have the necessary skills for actual work High-skilled personnel required by society with operational ability and foreign language application ability. The purpose of this article is to study the teaching innovation of the practical courses of tourism English in higher vocational colleges under the background of “Internet +”. This article uses a questionnaire survey to understand and summarize the current situation and existing problems of my country's higher vocational tourism English major curriculum from a practical point of view. On the basis of analyzing the current problems, it discusses the new ideas of constructing my country's higher vocational tourism English professional curriculum system under the background of “Internet +”. Propose an English course structure suitable for the major based on the integration of work and study, including course objectives, content, activities, methods, principles, etc. Trying to analyze and explore the characteristics of the major, cultivate professional talents needed by the society, and construct an English course that combines English and majors that adapt to the characteristics of the major. Compare students' learning effects before and after practice, and understand the impact of curriculum reform and teaching innovation on students' professional abilities. The experimental research results show that the teaching efficiency of practical courses after innovation is higher than that before innovation, which is 20-30% higher. It can be seen that innovation can better help teachers and students in teaching and learning, and innovation in the teaching of this course is imperative.

articleTitle: College English Network Teaching Based On Computer Network Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the context of interaction in the new era, the rapid development of China's computer network technology has affected China's education and brought new vitality to China's education. The traditional college English teaching model can hardly meet the needs of Chinese education and students. Therefore, in order to achieve the sustainable development of my country's college English teaching model, it is indispensable to use computer network technology for English teaching, change traditional teaching methods, skillfully use the multiple functions of computer network teaching, and add skillful teaching guidance. Can stimulate students' enthusiasm for independent learning and interest in English learning. The effective combination of college English teaching and computer network technology makes traditional teaching methods more diversified. However, the current college English teaching has not given full play to the role of computer network in teaching. If the College English teaching is not really integrated with the Internet, it can be found that most of the College English teaching can not be combined with the computer-assisted teaching tools. The integration of College English teaching mode into the network will not make the whole college English teaching interesting. Situational, cooperative and open learning can improve the teaching structure of College English. This paper takes the College English computer network teaching under the background of new era interaction as the research center, and makes a comprehensive analysis of its importance, advantages and points for attention, which can provide help for College English teachers. It also summarizes the improvement of College English teaching environment, innovation of teaching methods and improvement of teaching evaluation, hoping to provide effective help for College English teachers.

articleTitle: Research on the Reform of Mixed Teaching Model Based on MOOC
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the continuous application of information technology in the teaching of computer specialty in colleges and universities, it is necessary to reform the existing teaching mode to adapt to the development of information technology. The traditional teaching model is gradually impacted by new teaching methods such as flipped classroom, MOOC and rain classroom, which hinders the improvement of teaching quality in colleges and universities. The mixed teaching mode based on MOOC makes the education process more vivid and intuitive, can stimulate students' sensory organs in various aspects, improve learning efficiency, and effectively promote quality-oriented education and the cultivation of innovative talents. This paper takes Java course as an example to reform the teaching mode, and constructs a new hybrid teaching mode based on the integration of online and offline, which has been put into practice and achieved good results.

articleTitle: Securities Investment Course Reform Based on the Two-wheel Drive of Simulation and Practice
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper studies how to carry out securities investment course reform. All-round in-depth reform is performed based on two-wheel drive of simulation teaching of securities brokerage positions and securities investment practice teaching in light of securities investment theory teaching. Relevant innovations and reforms are made on assessment mode to replace static assessment with dynamic assessment from multiple results and multiple aspects, thus truly achieving a reform model of dual driving of theory and practice with dual assessments of static and dynamic assessment in teaching practice.

articleTitle: Discussion on College English Blended Teaching under MOOC
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: As an advanced way of education, MOOC (Massive Open Online Courses) is gradually introduced into traditional education in order to promote the quality of education. MOOC is also playing an important role in College English teaching. This paper firstly analyzes the meaning of MOOC and advantages of hybrid teaching, then it focuses on the implementation strategies of the mixed English teaching based on MOOC according to the current situation of College English Teaching in China. We hope that it provides a new way for College English teaching through this study.

articleTitle: A Project-Oriented Teaching Mode of E-Commerce Courses Based on CDIO
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Project-based teaching is commonly used in the higher vocational education. However, the random selection of projects leads to its lower effects. The CDIO (Conceive, Design, Implement, Operation) educational philosophy attaches more importance to projects and team work, and emphasizes allowing students to “learn by doing” throughout the entire process of a complete engineering project, which has been widely recognized by the engineering education community. Aiming at the conditions of higher vocational students and the teaching characteristics of E-Commerce courses, this paper analyzes the problems in project-based teaching, introduces the concept of CDIO education, and establishes a “project-oriented, student-centered, teacher-guided” project-based teaching model of E-Commerce courses in higher vocational colleges, aims to effectively improve the quality of project-based teaching in higher vocational E-Commerce courses.

articleTitle: Research and Prototype Implementation of Music Style Recognition and Generation Technology Based On Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Music can be divided into many genres, and some users are only interested in one or several genres. It is meaningful to identify and classify music genres through music style recognition system to improve user experience and facilitate users to retrieve and manage music. The Internet of things is an expanded application based on the Internet. It combines the network with various kinds of information sensing devices to form a huge network that can be interconnected anytime, anywhere. It can collect information data in real time, as well as intelligent identification, positioning, tracking, monitoring and management of goods. This paper discusses the research and prototype implementation of music style recognition and generation technology based on the Internet of things.

articleTitle: Teaching Reform of Network Courses Aiming at Student Management in Higher Vocational Colleges Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of science and technology, network technology has developed rapidly and has penetrated its tentacles into every corner of life. In education technology, the development and application of network education technology and network education platform will not only help improve the teaching level accelerates the reform of the education system, and can make up for the shortcomings of current education. The purpose of this article is to study the reform of the online course teaching of student management in higher vocational colleges. This article firstly analyzes the core technology, database, model architecture, etc. of the network course based on theory, and then results in the current situation of modern network course teaching in our country, to carry out the network course teaching of student management in higher vocational colleges. Applied research, and explored its course teaching reform path. This article systematically expounds the principles, advantages and disadvantages of current online course teaching, and conducts experimental research on the improvement of online course teaching that informs college student management through research methods such as questionnaire surveys and logical analysis. The research shows that the reformed higher vocational colleges Student-managed online courses are more efficient and more feasible.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Application of Computer Information Technology in the Community's Response to the COVID-19 ‐‐ Take Big Data as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: At the beginning of 2020, the COVID-19 broke out and spread rapidly in a short period of time. It has a serious impact on global political, economic and social stability. It has become a major public health incident that needs to be resolved urgently. With the development of computer information technology, big data provides a good technical way to prevent and respond to public crises. In the “Recent Work Plan for Prevention and Control of the COVID-19” promulgated by the State Council, it is pointed out that all localities should make full use of “big data + grid” and other means to do a good job in epidemic monitoring, detection, investigation, and early warning. Based on the background of the COVID-19, this article fully studies the application of computer technology in the community's response to new crown pneumonia and the existing problems, and is committed to improving the ability of computer technology to help solve public crises, giving full play to the convenient and efficient advantages of computer technology, and using computer information technology to build Co-build and share data network covering the whole country. The introduction of big data methods and means into the field of public management is an inevitable way to realize management modernization and an inevitable trend in the era of big data.

articleTitle: On the Present Situation and Future of Digital Image Intelligent Processing System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Computer technology is widely used in various industries. Since the digital image processing technology is realized based on computer technology, its future development space is very large. For some users who are new to digital image processing technology, the theoretical knowledge of this technology will be more difficult to understand. For the purpose of better solving this problem, the system is based on the Windows processing system in the design period so that it can further process images and import or export them. Thus, this system can be easier to understand and operate for people.

articleTitle: Online Network Teaching Module Construction of Mechatronics Comprehensive Training by Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: To satisfy the need of highly skilled and interdisciplinary talent under the situation of industry 4.0, Engineering Training Center of Jilin University increased the investment for improving hardware environment, obsoleted old equipment and bought new equipment for the development requirements of engineering students based on the old electrical training module to construct the online network teaching module of mechatronics comprehensive training. The equipment in this teaching module consisted largely of modern machine tools and new application equipment that used basic elements used in engineering control system, PLC(Programmable Logic Controller) and so on. The teaching module included basic circuitry training module, PLC training module and mechatronics training module. Multi-module teaching met the requirement of the students in different mayor and used the various measures of teaching method on online network platform that played an maj or role in improving the students' comprehensive ability and innovation ability.

articleTitle: “New Business” Talent Cultivation Practice Teaching Standard Design
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The proposal of ‘New Business' is a development and innovation of traditional business science, which provides a strategic solution to the talent training requirements and models in the new business era. This paper lays research focus on ‘new business' practical teaching standard design, so that capabilities, courses, enterprises, students can be determined via standard design, thereby achieving the goals of ‘order-oriented training’, ‘customized training’ and ‘embedded training’. It is very necessary that a systematic, dynamic and progressive ‘ternary flexible coupling practical teaching model’ with ability improvement as the goal, practical teaching system as the carrier and project system as the path. The ‘new business’ practical teaching system consists of five parts: cognitive practice, curriculum practice, independent experiment, off-campus professional practice, and graduation thesis (design).

articleTitle: Information Technology in the Study and Practice of Aerobics in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the information age of education and teaching, many colleges and universities apply information technology to college teaching. Aerobics is an important course in college physical education syllabus. The traditional aerobics teaching methods cannot meet the needs of the times, the emergence of information technology provides a certain convenience for aerobics teaching. In this paper, the test method is used to study. In the study, we selected two big class with the same number of people and similar basic situation as the experimental object, and the division is divided into class A and class B, among which class a adopts the traditional method to learn and practice aerobics, class B applies information technology to the study and practice of aerobics, And after the end of the semester, the situation of the two classes is analyzed. The results show that after the end of the semester, the average score of class a aerobics evaluation is 6.5, the average score of class B is 8.7, and the satisfaction of class A is 53.8%, and class B is 92.3%. Therefore, applying information technology to aerobics learning and training can not only effectively improve the learning effect, but also effectively improve the students' satisfaction.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Integration Mode of Computer Network and Business English Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the rapid development of economy and science and technology, international exchanges and cooperation have become more and more frequent. In business English teaching, teachers cannot simply tell students theoretical knowledge, but also need to provide students with more practice opportunities, and use computer network technology to expand students' English horizons and consolidate their English proficiency. This paper explores the importance of computer network applications in business English and proposes countermeasures for the integration of computer network and business English in order to strengthen the teaching efficiency of business English.

articleTitle: The Intervention of Moral Education Personalized Network Teaching Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the deepening of the new curriculum reform, the democratic equality between teachers and students, the need of students' personality development, the individualized classroom teaching of Ideological and moral character has become a very worthy of serious research. In the information explosion, the impact of information technology on educational reform is becoming more and more profound. It has become a national strategy to promote education modernization with information technology. The purpose of this paper is to build a personalized network teaching platform for moral education and promote the moral education information teaching. Based on the demand of moral education individualization in the view of big data, this paper constructs and realizes the moral education network teaching platform with personalized recommendation function. The whole system architecture is designed, the technical feasibility and data feasibility of realizing the system function are analyzed, and the difficulties of developing the system are determined. Learn and master various technical development schemes such as LDA document theme model and recommendation algorithm. According to the requirement analysis, the system function module is realized, the function and performance test of the system are completed, and the test results are analyzed. When the number of users is within 3000, the CPU utilization rate changes slowly, the utilization rate is within 10%, but more than 3000 people, the CPU utilization rate increases rapidly, and the performance of the system is obviously decreased. Because the limit of the number of users is 1000, the system can still meet the needs well.

articleTitle: The Listening Strategies of Non English Majors in Colleges and Universities Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the further development of economic globalization, there is an increasing demand for English talents for international communication. Listening plays an important role in foreign language learning and communication. Listening is the most important but also the most difficult part of English language skills, and the study of listening learning strategies has attracted great attention. However, at present, the English listening level of non English majors(NEM) is still unsatisfactory. In view of this situation, more and more scholars begin to pay attention to learners' own factors, such as the influence of learning strategies on listening acquisition. The study finds that the use of learning strategies has a positive role in promoting students' English listening. This paper mainly studies the English Listening Strategies of College NEM Based on artificial intelligence. This paper expounds the process of listening strategies of NEM in Colleges and universities(CAU), and guides the students to use listening strategies before, during and after listening. It also puts forward some effective countermeasures to improve the listening level of NEM. This paper mainly uses questionnaire to study the listening strategies of NEM in CA U. The results show that meta cognitive strategies play a very important role in guiding and regulating foreign language learning. The average score of high score group in topic 1 is 3.48, that of low score group is 2.44, that of high score group is 1.12, and that of low score group is 0.91.

articleTitle: Application and Research of Computer Network-based Teaching Platform in Higher Vocational English Blended Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the rapid development of network information technology, hybrid teaching based on computer network teaching platform has become a new teaching mode. Based on constructing the application foundation of blended English teaching in higher vocational colleges, this paper expounds the classification and content of network teaching platform, and explores the effective ways and methods of blended teaching, so as to effectively construct the blended English teaching mode in higher vocational colleges.

articleTitle: Teaching Research on Database Principle and Application Course Based on Computing Thinking and CDIO Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Discusses the problem of training students' computing thinking in the teaching of database principles and applications, and analyses the computing thinking reflected in the course of database principles and applications. In the course of teaching, the training of computational thinking is penetrated into the teaching content, and the course practice teaching is carried out by using the CDIO engineering teaching method to strengthen the training of students' Computational Thinking ability.

articleTitle: Individualized Training Model of College Teachers Based on Artificial Intelligence Platforms: An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The field of AI is developing rapidly, as is the convergence of AI and educational disciplines. In the field of teacher training in colleges, how to use artificial intelligence, personalized to improve the teaching ability, scientific research ability of teachers in colleges and universities, has become a priority. This study explores how to construct a personalized training model for teachers in colleges Based on artificial intelligence platforms and personalized recommended algorithms, and measures the effectiveness of this model. At a university in China, there are 23 faculty for two-week teacher training based on the “xtangx” AI platform, and the training process makes full use of both the AI platform and AI tools. The evaluation of training effectiveness was analyzed using a combination of qualitative and quantitative analysis. The results showed that: (1) more than 95% of teachers believed that the use of AI platforms, can enhance the training effect. (2) Training was able to meet individualized learning needs with good overall satisfaction. The model provided in this study is meaningful for enhancing the advantages of talents training and scientific research in Colleges and universities, and promoting the application of artificial intelligence technology.

articleTitle: The Influence of Intrinsic Motivation on Teaching Performance Evaluation of Shandong Applied Universities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Exploring the effect of application-oriented universities teachers' intrinsic motivation on the teaching performance is very important. In the study, 420 valid questionnaires were collected. Based on the Exploratory Factor Analysis, the empirically tests of the intrinsic motivation on the teaching performance are studied by using the path analysis method of Structural Equation Model. The results show that intrinsic motivation includes four factors, which are innovation motivation, achievement motivation, emotion motivation and responsibility motivation. The effect of achievement motivation on teaching performance is not significant. Innovation motivation and responsibility motivation have positive influences on teaching performance, while emotion motivation has negative influence on teaching performance. The above results have certain reference value for the management reform of teaching in Chinese application-oriented universities.

articleTitle: Path Exploration of Construction of Online and Offline Mode in Teaching for College Sports Based on Internet Plus
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: As rapid advancement of network based IT and multimedia technology, penetration of the education industry was gaining momentum. Offline teaching mode is gradually transformed into the integrated mode in online and offline teaching, and it has injected new vitality into college physical education. The teaching mode by online and offline of college physical education constructed based on Internet + is developing towards multi-media assisted teaching, network teaching and other diversified and integrated trends, but there are still certain issues in the application of practical teaching. Therefore, it is significant to study the path of the online and offline teaching mode of college physical education from the perspective of Internet +, and it is of great theoretical and practical significance to better apply the integrated teaching mode and put forward targeted improvement strategies to enhance the innovation physical education in teaching mode and enhance the teaching quality.

articleTitle: The Application of PDA in Online and Offline Mixed Teaching of College English
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Language teaching and learning has entered the digital era with the wide application of information technology in the field of education. The learning software based on mobile client is the online teaching platform of superstar company. Using mobile client to combine online and offline teaching enabled students can better invest in learning, rather than indulge in games or the Internet.

articleTitle: Tennis Teaching Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper studies the advantages of information technology in the current tennis teaching, from a number of international tennis education system and health standards to evaluate the efficiency of the current Chinese tennis teaching methods. This paper constructs a joint model of information technology tennis teaching factors, and studies tennis teaching from the perspectives of health, tennis learning effect and crowd management. Research shows that the use of information technology can improve students' learning effect from the perspective of students' learning interest and health. Based on the analysis of the current students' tennis learning time, the use of information technology multimedia and intelligent equipment for teaching can improve students' learning efficiency by more than 65% compared with missionary teaching, and the students' bad mental health phenomenon in this case can be reduced by more than 35%, Students' physique can be improved by more than 45%. In addition, students' tennis learning skills can be improved by more than 50%. Therefore, the use of multimedia tennis teaching for students can improve the teaching effect, and improve the physical quality of students.

articleTitle: Exploration of Experiment Teaching of Mechanical Specialty Based on New Engineering Background
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Practice teaching is an important part of undergraduate teaching, especially in Local Application-oriented Universities. Practice teaching is an important means for colleges and universities to cultivate students' practical ability and scientific research ability, and to improve students' comprehensive quality. It is also an important link for colleges and universities to carry out industrial integration and accelerate the transformation of local colleges and universities to application-oriented colleges and universities. Under the background of new engineering, our school, as an engineering college, should seize the development opportunity under the situation of “new engineering”, pay more attention to practical teaching, strengthen the management of practical teaching, and focus on the reform and innovation of practical teaching. Practice teaching management is the unified planning and arrangement of practice courses, practice activities, graduation practice, production practice and other teaching links in Colleges and universities, which is an important guarantee to ensure the normal and orderly progress of practice teaching.

articleTitle: Greenhouse Planting System Design Based On LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The Greenhouse Planting system design combined with STC89 micro control unit, LabVIEW graphical programming software, Keil u Vision4, Altium Designer and other software as the auxiliary design is studied in this paper. The system is mainly divided into LCD display module, serial communication module, stepper motor, TLC549 digital to analog conversion, soil moisture sensor, temperature and humidity sensor DHT11, motor driven L298N module USB camera and so on. LabVIEW software is used by the system to control the changes of environmental factors in the greenhouse. The functions of the system are described as follows: The greenhouse planting system design is able to collect information of environmental factors through sensors, and the collected information can be displayed on the LCD display screen. At the same time, the data can also be transmitted to the Lab Viewserver-side, which can receive and send data to the Lab Viewclient side through the internet, and the Lab Viewclient side can control the water pump and fan switch remotely.

articleTitle: Promote the Reform of Analytical Chemistry Teaching Mode with “Internet + Discipline Competition” as the Guide
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Based on years of course teaching practice in analytical chemistry, this paper takes “Internet + discipline competition” as a guidance, refers to the teaching modes and methods of famous schools at home and abroad, and establishes a complete analytical teaching model, including the creation of COME teaching model, exploratory experimental teaching, establishment of echelon training mechanism. By constructing an analytical chemistry teaching model guided by “Internet + discipline competition”, teaching activities are truly based on students' independent learning and active exploration, so that students transform from passive learning to active and inquiry teaching. In this way, a teaching system conducive to healthy development of innovative consciousness and innovative ability is formed.

articleTitle: MOOC Mixed Impact on Teaching College English Graded Teaching ESP
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The country's demand for talents with higher English literacy is more and more urgent in the era of internationalization. The rise and development of MOOC (Massive Open On Line Course) is explosive in China, and it has been widely used in various courses of universities, improving the teaching quality and education level effectively. ESP (English for Specific purposes), as a core course to improve students' professional English literacy, plays an irreplaceable role. Traditional ESP teaching has some shortcomings, such as single teaching mode, boring teaching process, obsolete teaching resources, etc. The teaching reform is imperative in order to meet the needs of the times. The emergence of MOOC brings opportunities for ESP teaching. This paper puts forward the exploration direction of ESP teaching based on the teaching advantages of MOOC and the teaching characteristics of ESP.

articleTitle: Experimental Teaching of “Online and Offline” Converged Media from the Perspective of Informatization
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Our country's economy is developing rapidly, and information technology has also emerged under the economic development. In our country's school education, the shadow of information technology has gradually appeared, from universities across the country to middle schools in county towns, all of which have more or less introduced modern teaching technology. Informatization vision technology has been developed in all aspects of the education industry, the value of products and services created has gradually increased, and experimental teaching under informatization technology plays an important role. This article mainly introduces the experimental teaching research of “online and offline” fusion media from the perspective of informatization. This article uses the “online and offline” experimental teaching research of integrated media from the perspective of informatization, starting from the two aspects of informatization and online and offline employment, and rationally analyzes the feasibility of experimental teaching of integrated media. The demand for integrated media teaching in my country's education market is concentrated, but the teaching purpose of many schools mostly stays in traditional research teaching, which leads to a decline in the quality of education and it is difficult to meet the market's demand for experimental teaching. The use of integrated media for experimental teaching is the decision. The subject of curriculum content and teaching mode. The experimental results of this paper show that the “online and offline” integrated media experimental teaching research under the information field has increased the teaching efficiency by 26%, and the limitations of the “online and offline” integrated media experimental teaching research under the information field Analyze, discuss and summarize the methods and approaches of media course teaching, so as to enrich the academic research results.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Augmented Reality Technology in College English Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Augmented Reality (AR) is a technology that can innovate traditional education. This technology connects virtual objects with the real world, and it can visualize complex spatial relationships and abstract concepts, it also deepen people's perception of the surrounding environment and understanding of knowledge, and enable learners to experience impossible phenomena in the real world. AR brings new opportunities for teaching innovation. On the basis of the technical characteristics of augmented reality and the advantages of its application, and by analyzing the problems facing college English teaching, the paper discusses the advantages of augmented reality in college English teaching and the practice of teaching activities. It can promote the vigorous development of English classroom based on the deep integration of augmented reality technology and English teaching. The purpose of this paper is to provide reference model and educational theory support for the introduction of augmented reality technology into college English classroom.

articleTitle: Innovation of Teaching Mode of Construction Engineering Specialty in Colleges and Enterprises from the Perspective of AR Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: As one of the pillar industries of our national economy, the construction industry not only involves dozens of upstream and downstream industries, but also is closely related to the life of tens of millions of families. China is in the painful period of industrial structure adjustment and reform. In order to train more innovative talents, compound talents and high-quality talents, and improve the comprehensive quality and international competitiveness of construction engineering and technical personnel, the construction industry needs to compete for the market with innovation as the core competitiveness. Through 300 questionnaires, this paper concludes that the cultivation of construction engineering talents with social responsibility and professional achievements in colleges and universities is of profound significance to the development of construction industry.

articleTitle: Practice and Exploration of Artificial Intelligence Education in Chinese Universities Based on the STEAM Concept
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: At present, China's emerging technologies enjoy vigorous development, and emerging industrial chain with artificial intelligence and big data as the mainstay has dominated China's new economic form. With it, the question of how to cultivate innovative and compound talents in emerging disciplines has become one core difficulty in the current higher education. The highly interdisciplinary integrated STEAM education is suitable for the initial training of new talents. This paper studies the status quo of STEAM education and artificial intelligence education in Chinese universities. Based on the practice of STEAM talent training in Anshan Normal University, it combines artificial intelligence-related education practice, tracks and analyzes various indicators of students in STEAM course to explore the feasibility plan for artificial intelligence education in Chinese universities.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Construction of Cloud Platform for Clarinet Teaching in Mobile Terminal
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper makes a survey based on the clarinet education in music colleges. This paper analyzes the existing problems of clarinet education in music colleges, constructs a clarinet teaching mode based on the mobile terminal network, and considers the MOOC teaching mode and combining the knowledge characteristics of clarinet education. The platform will sort out the domestic clarinet education resources, complete the clarinet network education resources as much as possible, and meet the needs of College Students' artistic, personalized and diversified clarinet education.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation Index System of Practice Education Quality of Business Majors
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Practical education is an important guarantee for business majors to achieve the goal of personnel training, and the quality evaluation of practical education affects the effect of practical education to a great extent, as well as the management and decision-making of schools. From a macro perspective, based on CIPP evaluation model and the relevant departments of education policy and education in the teaching evaluation standard, etc., this paper builds the practical education quality evaluation index system for business majors. It will evaluate the practical education quality from the four primary index: the background, the input, the process, and the results of practical education.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation Strategy of Online Music Live Teaching System in Post-epidemic Era Based on Network Information Dissemination
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet and information technology, the mode of information dissemination and its research paradigm have undergone tremendous changes. Based on network information dissemination technology, this paper analyzes the advantages of music online live teaching, and designs the music online live teaching system, including system architecture design, real-time message transmission protocol interaction process design, and live server subsystem design. The live server subsystem is used to receive the user's video service request, provide a real-time content stream in a suitable format, and implement real-time streaming control according to the user's request. In order to adapt to the online live music teaching in the post-epidemic era, an implementation strategy for online music live teaching is proposed to give full play to the functions of the direct teaching system.

articleTitle: Research on English Informatization Teaching in Higher Vocational Colleges Based on Visual Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In English teaching in higher vocational colleges, through the effective application of visual information technology, it can effectively improve the teaching content and the pertinence, rich diversity and effectiveness of teaching formation, help students master more suitable learning methods, so as to promote the overall improvement of their English level and professional accomplishment. This paper discusses the application strategy of visual information technology in English information teaching in higher vocational colleges from three stages: before, during and after class.

articleTitle: Mathematics Education and Teaching Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The velocity of circulation of information continues to increase, the amount of data marks China's fast growth has officially entered the new age of information, the development and popularization of big data to transform human life, but also promote the transformation and upgrade of the various areas, especially large data analysis, for the school education plays an vital role in promoting transformation of education. For the sake of conform to the boom of the era of big data, from the perspective of education, teachers should reform mathematics education and teaching by combining big data analysis, realize the two gradually enter the category of deep cooperation, integrate the conventional teaching experience, and upgrade mathematics education and teaching. It is analyzed in the context of this paper the large data using computer multimedia technology to build a new sports teaching pattern, and by using the formula for calculating the efficiency and the quality is calculated, based on analysis of large data in mathematics education teaching practice in the classroom teaching efficiency and quality of data with 22% and 41% respectively than conventional mathematics education teaching, and further expounded based on analysis of large data mathematics education teaching for students to learn mathematics has a positive role.

articleTitle: Research on Smart Phone Assisted College English ESP Blended Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: As the main medium and carrier of mobile learning, Smart phone can become a powerful learning tool, change the teaching method, and reshape learning behavior. This paper analyzes the application of smart phones in College English ESP (English for Specific Purposes) hybrid teaching, as well as the learning behavior and learning effect of learners assisted by smart phones by collecting background data of MOOC (Massive Open Online Courses) course platform. The results show that, teachers can create a personalized language learning environment based on mobile phone MOOC provide learners with learning guidance and promotion services in multiple ways, provide learners with learning support anytime and anywhere, and ultimately improve learners' learning engagement and satisfaction with the help of smart phones.

articleTitle: Research on the Teaching Mode and Trend of Foreign Language Translation Education in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The concept of foreign language translation education research in Colleges and universities has undergone a transformation from translation training to translation education.
