At present, the problems of foreign language translation teaching mode in Colleges and universities are mainly reflected in the continuous expansion and deepening of teaching scope and content, the subject framework needs to be expanded and improved, and the dislocation of supply and demand of translation talents. At present, there are many problems in translation teaching in Chinese colleges and universities, which make it difficult for the actual translation industry to achieve the expected goal. Based on this, this paper analyzes the current problems and development trend of foreign language translation teaching in China, and puts forward the corresponding development countermeasures.

articleTitle: Exploration and Research on Blended Teaching Mode Based on Mobile Terminal
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: This paper takes the “3ds max” course as an example, based on the application of cloud classes, to explore and research the blended teaching mode based on mobile terminals. Constructed a blended teaching model based on cloud class, and proposed the implementation process of this teaching model.

articleTitle: Exploration and Practice of Modularized Teaching of Software Technology Specialty Based on Professional Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Since the first electronic computer came out, computer hardware technology has been continuously developing, followed by computer software technology. In order to cultivate computer software talents, colleges and universities have gradually established computer software-related colleges. The main purpose of this article is to explore the modularized teaching and practice of software technology specialty based on professional characteristics. This article is a new review and discussion of the current software technology major related course teaching and talent training mode under the background of the rapid development of the computer software technology industry. Based on the characteristics of related courses of software technology major, as well as the analysis of the current situation and existing problems of related courses of software technology major, this paper proposes to adopt modular teaching mode to cultivate the comprehensive information literacy, innovation ability and practical ability of software technology students. The ability to meet the professional characteristics of software technology. This article expounds the concept of modular teaching, and on this basis, focuses on the basic principles of modular teaching design in software technology professional courses, and constructs a modular teaching model for the “java programming” course. Through the comparative practical research of modular teaching in the course of “Java Programming”, it can be seen that the average grade of the class using modular teaching is about 8 points higher than that of the class using the original teaching model. More than 80% of the classes that use modular teaching are interested in the “Java Programming” course. The above experimental results show that modular teaching can effectively improve students' performance, enhance students' interest in learning, and cultivate students' professional characteristics.

articleTitle: Design and Suggestions on Digital Resource Storage System of Shaobei Martial Arts Culture Based on Hadoop in Internet Era
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Cultural protection in the Internet age has new characteristics. Digital protection is replacing traditional technical means and becoming a new means of cultural protection. Shaobei martial arts has become an organic part and unique form of expression of the entire Chinese culture. Researching its digital protection will help realize the full utilization and sharing of Shaobei martial arts cultural resources. This article analyzes the connotation and value of Shaobei martial arts culture; standardizes the collection, processing, storage, and dissemination of the digital protection of Shaobei martial arts culture; researches the key technologies of Shaobei martial arts culture digital resource storage based on HADOOP; recommendations for the protection of digital resources of northern martial arts culture: use the “Software as a Service” system application model to support the transformation of digital resources into industrial resources.

articleTitle: A Capability-oriented Method for Integration of Liberal Arts Knowledge Graph in Primary Education
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Education is one of the major problems in people's livelihood in China nowadays, especially in field of basic primary education. Personalized learning is a very important research and application topic in field of primary education, in which the construction of knowledge graph is the core and foundation of application. This paper focuses on constructing and integrating the knowledge graph of liberal arts subject in field of primary education. First, the liberal arts concepts are extracted and subject ontologies are constructed. Second, multi-disciplinary ontology is integrated to construct the conceptual model of field of Liberal arts. Third, the method of acquiring data layer of knowledge graph is discussed and implemented. At last, the application of knowledge graph in field of primary education is listed, and the practice of this method provides ideas for the construction of knowledge graph in field of primary education, and also knowledge graph of liberal arts can provide support for personalized education applications.

articleTitle: Combination of Computer Multimedia Technology and English Teaching
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the advent of the information age, the application of computer multimedia technology in the field of education has become more and more extensive. Many college teachers have integrated multimedia technology into modern teaching, which has not only changed the traditional blackboard teaching method, but also aroused students' great interest in learning, and achieved better classroom teaching results. This article analyzes and studies the combination of computer multimedia technology and English teaching. In this article, we first use constructivism theory, psychology and basic theories of pedagogy as the theoretical basis to analyze some of the characteristics and advantages of the integration of multimedia technology and English teaching, and compare it with traditional education, and propose multimedia under the new curriculum standard. The necessity of integrating technology with college English teaching. Reuse education survey to study students' acceptance and attitude towards the combination of computer multimedia technology and English teaching. The experimental results show that 67% of students in multimedia teaching believe that the use of multimedia technology can effectively improve the classroom atmosphere and make the classroom atmosphere more active. Therefore, when teachers are teaching, they can effectively improve students' interest in learning English through multimedia teaching.

articleTitle: Space Simulation and Environment Construction of Urban Public Facilities Based On VR Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Virtual reality technology can provide the public with an immersive sense of participation, promote the public's cognition and evaluation of urban design, and has application value in the field of public participation in urban design. However, there are still some problems in the application of VR in public participation in urban design, such as the weak theoretical basis, which limits its application and promotion. The purpose of this study is to supplement the research on the theoretical basis and application methods of VR application in the field of public participation in urban design, try to build a method with theoretical basis, which can meet the two-way balance of public participation, and guide the effective application of VR in the field of public participation in urban design. VR can support the public to recognize the meso and micro scale content of urban design, and has the advantages of cognition, evaluation and mobilization of participation enthusiasm. This paper summarizes the rules of VR application in public participation in urban design, and verifies some application rules through public participation experiments.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Teaching Resource Database for Musicology (Normal) Major Based on Information Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Online teaching resources are the prerequisite and foundation for the development of online education. With the gradual expansion of online education, online teaching resources are becoming more and more abundant. Effective management of teaching resources has become the key to developing online education, providing efficient storage for various learning content objects management. The network teaching resource database is a resource management platform integrating resource distributed storage, resource management, resource evaluation, and knowledge management. Based on the information processing technology, this paper analyzes the needs of the teaching resource database, and designs the overall structure consisting of the infrastructure layer, the support platform layer, the software service layer and the user access layer, and the curriculum construction, the construction of the teaching staff and the construction of teaching materials of the musicology (normal college) major were studied in order to give full play to the role of the educational resource database.

articleTitle: College English Teaching Strategies based on Rain Classroom Teaching Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the in-depth advance of computer network technology, modern information technology has gradually been applied to teaching. The network education has prompted changes in teachers' teaching strategies. By using the Rain Classroom for teaching, teachers can fully understand students' online learning behaviors and propose teaching strategies suitable for students' online learning. In this paper, the practice of college English teaching in the light of the Rain Classroom is carried out. The empirical results show that brainstorming, feedback on answers and peer evaluation are students' favorites. It shows that the use of above teaching strategies can stimulate students' effective learning behavior, and further the development of students' knowledge and ability. The study will definitely push forward the in-depth reform of college English teaching and provide lessons for teaching research.

articleTitle: Research on Ideological and Political Course Teaching in Colleges and Universities from the Perspective of New Development Concept
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Ideological and political course is the central link and key course of educational work in colleges and universities, and plays an extremely important role. How can we make the ideological and political course realize its due educational effect and train qualified socialist constructors and reliable successors? This requires the ideological and political course to take the new development concept as the guide, to establish the “problem consciousness”, to take the problem as the guide, to carryon the thematic teaching.

articleTitle: Explore Design Evaluation Method Based on Universal Design in Human-Products Interactive of the Product Development
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: As we all know, product development involves many factors, so the evaluation results of key frames in product development are very important. The Universal Design Principles have a significant guiding for product design, especially in terms of human-robot interaction. This article mainly to focused on how to use of Universal Design Principles in the product development process, to help design teams evaluate and screen design options, especially for evaluating the influence on human-robot interaction cause by the forms. In this article, there will be mainly using the Universal Design to re-evaluate the development process of a product based on the universal evaluation method was used for three times to promote the generation of product solutions.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of College Student Management System Based on Information Technology under Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: With the popularization of education informatization, colleges and universities generally have information management systems, which can manage school information, teacher information, student information, and performance information, and are equipped with special databases or data clusters to store this information. How to effectively use these data to extract and mine valuable information from these data, so as to provide schools and teachers with auxiliary decision-making, and truly improve the level and quality of school running has become an issue worthy of attention. The purpose of this paper is to design and implement the university management system based on big data technology. This paper firstly summarizes the basic theory of big data and derives the core technology of big data data mining and other core technologies, combined with the current university student management system in our country. The status quo, analysis of its problems and shortcomings, on this basis, combined with big data technology to design and analyze the college student management system. This article systematically expounds the design and use of the database, function modules and related technologies of the management system. And conduct research through research methods such as comparison and field investigation. Experimental research shows that compared with the traditional college student management system, the college student management system based on big data technology is more practical and more powerful.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Technology in Track and Field Physical Education
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The traditional physical education depends on action demonstration, equipment and field of the professor, which has great limitations. Integrating CT(computer technology, hereinafter referred to as CT) into traditional physical education can not limited to many conditions of traditional mode and help to realize the progress of physical education. The computer industry continues to develop, a variety of CT has entered the classroom, physical education and other subjects, teaching content, methods and methods are constantly changing and developing, especially in the course of physical education, multimedia technology has been used to improve the level of physical education theory teaching. Multimedia courseware provides visual, auditory and other information channels. According to the requirements of teachers, teachers can freely obtain, process and display all kinds of images and images, so as to change the original boring and rigid curriculum into vivid, interesting and vivid. It vividly describes various, complex and abstract sports images and forms with pictures and words. Colorful animation can vividly simulate all kinds of sports technology, and fully demonstrate sports technology. Through the simple analysis of the time and space characteristics of sports presenters, It can strengthen students' understanding of sports knowledge. At the same time, the human-computer interaction provided by multimedia is of special significance to stimulate students' interest in learning, mobilize their enthusiasm and leadership, and develop their personal potential. In track and field sports teaching, there are many items which are difficult for teachers to judge and demonstrate accurately. It is necessary to use mathematical algorithm combined with CT for better teaching demonstration and teaching verification.

articleTitle: A Survey on the Recognition of College Students' Learning Motivation by Different Teaching Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Teaching method is the embodiment of the behavior of both teachers and students in teaching activities. Different teaching methods are suitable for different teaching objectives and course contents. The reform and application of teaching methods are the needs of the continuous development of education. The junior college students were the subjects and survey of network questionnaire and field interview were used to evaluate the recognition of students on 11 teaching method in the present study. The results showed that college students' recognition of traditional teaching methods, such as case discussion, teaching and enterprise practice, which were top 3 teaching methods. But the recognition of homework/exercises, talk teaching and systematic training for the whole week came to the bottom. However all the 11 teaching methods did not have significant differences. Different teaching methods all have their merits. The key was that teachers should analyze the learning situation and choose the appropriate teaching methods according to the teaching content and teaching objectives of the course. However, colleges are keen on concentrated practical training, and the teaching mode of offering full-week practical courses, which should arouse great attention. It is necessary to plan and improve students' motivation and interest in full-week practical learning from the perspectives of top-level professional design, careful planning of courses, professional implementation process and effectiveness of result assessment.

articleTitle: Application of Multi-level Practical Teaching Mode in Practical Teaching of Stomatology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The innovation and development of modern medicine put forward higher requirements for medical teaching, so it not only pays attention to practical teaching, but also highlights the cultivation of ability, which mainly dues to advanced teaching ideas and diversified teaching methods. Besides the commonness of medical teaching, stomatology teaching also has its own speciality. The speciality of stomatology and maxillofacial makes its surgical practice difficult and the corresponding teaching challenge high. The comprehensive application of multi-level practical teaching mode in teaching can improve students' practical ability and create “generalists ”. This work mainly discussed the application of multi-level practical teaching mode in practical teaching of stomatology with various teaching modes in detail, and clarified its concrete implementation strategy to realize the cultivation of high-quality professional stomatology talents.

articleTitle: Competency Training Ability of College Counselors Based on Intelligent Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: College counselors are an important part of the faculty of colleges and universities, the backbone of the ideological and political education of college students, and the main force in the work of college students. The 21st century we live in is a highly intelligent era. With the continuous emergence of intelligent computing as a typical technical means in contemporary network technology, the relationship between intelligent computing and people's life and work is getting closer and closer. However, college counselors are also facing many new problems and challenges. Therefore, how to improve the use of intelligent computing and better improve the competence of counselors has become a difficult problem for colleges and universities. Based on this, this article launched a research on the competency training ability of college counselors based on intelligent computing. This article uses behavioral incident interview method, literature analysis method and questionnaire survey method to carry out research. Through interviews with counselors, the competency characteristics of counselors are obtained, and the competency model of counselors is established. By consulting the literature, compiling questionnaires, designing a complete set of questionnaires in line with the research, and issuing questionnaires to 60% of college counselors and teachers to obtain the most authentic data. Collect relevant data through questionnaire surveys, and then enter the collected data into the database for data analysis. By consulting related materials, using publicly published papers and works at home and abroad as references, we can obtain basic theoretical support and background materials, as well as the current status and development level of the research on the competence of counselors. The survey results show that counselors have a strong understanding of work. Generally, 45% are familiar with them, 18% are relatively familiar, and few are very familiar. 40% of counselors think they have average competence. 44 % of counselors voluntarily signed up and wanted to participate in training to improve themselves. 51% of counselors believe that the best time for a training session is half a day. Regarding the training goals, only a small number of instructors have clear training goals. It can be seen that the research on the competence training ability of college counselors is of extremely high value.

articleTitle: Application of Blended Teaching Mode Based on Constructivism Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: The constructivism theory emphasizes the student's main body position in the teaching process, highlights the teacher's guidance and the supervision function. Based on the connotation of the constructivism theory, with the aid of modern multimedia teaching technology, taking “Basic Accounting” course as an example, constructs “Blended Teaching” situation of before-class (online), during-class (offline), after-class(online and offline), explores the “online and offline” blended teaching innovative way under the perspective of constructivism theory, and evaluates the implementation effect of this teaching method.

articleTitle: Reform of Informatization Teaching in Universities under “Internet Plus” Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: As is known to all, universities, as the front positions of the state and society in developing and implementing all advanced educational strategies, are bound to face new challenges and tests in the teaching reform in the context of “Internet plus”. However, there are some problems in teaching in universities in China, such as obsolete teaching ideas, single teaching content and low teaching facilities, which are all main obstacles in the reform of informatization teaching in universities in the context of “Internet plus”. Therefore, to achieve the ideal effect of informatization teaching, universities must adopt practical means and methods to comprehensively improve the quality and level of informatization teaching. Thus, the reform of informatization teaching in universities in the context of “Internet plus” is deeply analyzed.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Dual Axis Stabilization System for Vehicle Weapon Based on Angular Rate Compensation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: A dual axis stabilization system for vehicle weapon is proposed, disturbance model of three-axis attitude of the vehicle platform to the weapon firing line is obtained by establishing coordinate system. On this basis, the velocity compensation model of the weapon stabilization system is proposed. The simulation results show that this method can effectively isolate the three-axis attitude disturbance of vehicle platform, realize the closed-loop stable control of vehicle weapon shooting line in geodetic coordinate system, meeting the requirements of the system, having good control effect as well.

articleTitle: The Transformation and Development of Chinese Legal Education Model under the Background of the COVID-19 Epidemic
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: Chinese traditional legal education model attaches great importance to the indoctrination of knowledge and the interpretation of the law. On account of its weak practical attributes, complex subject classification, and outdated teaching methods, the traditional legal education effect was negatively impacted by the convoluted curriculum design, poor interaction between teachers and students and unscientific evaluation mechanism. The rapid development of information technology has created new opportunities for the Chinese legal education model in current new era. Influenced by the COVID-19 epidemic, Chinese colleges and universities integrate online and offline legal teaching resources actively, explore the advantages such like immediacy and high efficiency of online teaching model. The improvement of Chinese legal education model will promote the comprehensive construction of a modern and powerful socialist country.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Characteristics of China's Undergraduate Teaching Review and Evaluation Standards based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
abstract: In the context of artificial intelligence, the Nvivo12 software was used to analyze the word frequency of the national undergraduate teaching audit and evaluation standards, and perform primary coding and mark reference points for the elements in the national audit and evaluation standards. In addition, text analysis of the audit evaluation standards of 8 provinces that are different from the documents issued by the Ministry of Education among the audit evaluation standards of 29 local governments was carried out, and the audit evaluation standards and self-evaluation reports of 33 universities were randomly sampled. From the perspective of organic philosophy, this paper explains the characteristics of China's undergraduate teaching audit and evaluation standards, which provides a basis for the improvement of China's undergraduate teaching audit and evaluation standards.
